evals.prompt: Review the sessions and artifacts for a completed Parent/Child spec delivery and tell me what the Agent Delivery Workflow should learn from it.
evals.expected_output: Findings-first meta-review with reconstructed flow, session/artifact references, prioritized workflow improvements, and a next best patch.

evals.prompt: We closed a child spec but the next session hit stale handoff and verification command issues. Analyze the workflow and patch small obvious process improvements.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based analysis plus small targeted workflow/skill/template patches, with broad changes and decisions separated.

evals.prompt: After working on a parent spec across several child sessions, run the self-optimization review so future Agent Delivery sessions avoid the same mistakes.
evals.expected_output: Parent/child flow reconstruction, P0-P3 findings, applied learning updates, and follow-up automation or validator ideas.
